column1: Within Australia, Australian Hotels Inc (AHI) operates nine hotels and employs over 2000 permanent full-time staff, 300 permanent part-time employees and 100 casual staff.
column2: 在澳大利亚，澳大利亚酒店公司（AHI）运营九家酒店，拥有超过2000名全职员工、300名兼职员工和100名临时工。

column1: One of its latest ventures, the Sydney Airport hotel (SAH), opened in March 1995.
column2: 其最新投资项目之一是悉尼机场酒店，该酒店于1995年3月开业。

column1: The hotel is the closest to Sydney Airport and is designed to provide the best available accommodation, food and beverage and meeting facilities in Sydney’s southern suburbs.
column2: 这家酒店距离悉尼机场最近，旨在为悉尼南郊的旅客提供最优质的住宿、餐饮和会议设施。

column1: Similar to many international hotel chains, however, AHI has experienced difficulties in Australia in providing long-term profits for hotel owners, as a result of the country’s high labour-cost structure.
column2: 与许多国际连锁酒店集团类似，AHI在澳大利亚也面临为酒店业主提供长期利润的困难，这源于该国高昂的劳动力成本结构。

column1: In order to develop an economically viable hotel organisation model, AHI decided to implement some new policies and practices at SAH.
column2: 为了开发出一种经济可行的酒店运营模式，AHI决定在SAH实施一些新的政策与措施。

column1: The first of the initiatives was an organisational structure with only three levels of management – compared to the traditional seven.
column2: 第一项举措是采用了只有三级管理层的组织结构——而传统的方式则是七级管理层。

column1: Partly as a result of this change, there are 25 per cent fewer management positions, enabling a significant saving.
column2: 由于这一变化，管理岗位的数量减少了25%，从而实现了显著的成本节约。

column1: This change also has other implications.
column2: 这一变化还伴随着其他一些影响。

column1: Communication, both up and down the organisation, has greatly improved.
column2: 组织内部的上下沟通已得到显著改善。

column1: Decision-making has been forced down in many cases to front-line employees.
column2: 在许多情况下，决策权已被下放至一线员工。

column1: As a result, guest requests are usually met without reference to a supervisor, improving both customer and employee satisfaction.
column2: 因此，客户的需求通常可以在无需咨询主管的情况下得到满足，从而提升了客户和员工的满意度。

column1: The hotel also recognised that it would need a different approach to selecting employees who would fit in with its new policies.
column2: 这家酒店也意识到，需要采用不同的方法来选拔那些能够适应其新政策的员工。

column1: In its advertisements, the hotel stated a preference for people with some ‘service’ experience in order to minimise traditional work practices being introduced into the hotel.
column2: 在广告中，该酒店明确表示倾向于雇佣具有某些‘服务’经验的人，以避免将传统的工作方式引入酒店。

column1: Over 7000 applicants filled in application forms for the 120 jobs initially offered at SAH.
column2: 在SAH提供的120个职位中，有超过7000名申请人填写了申请表。

column1: The balance of the positions at the hotel (30 management and 40 shift leader positions) were predominantly filled by transfers from other AHI properties.
column2: 这家酒店的管理岗位共有30个，轮班负责人有40个职位，这些职位的主要人选均来自AHI其他门店的调动人员。

column1: A series of tests and interviews were conducted with potential employees, which eventually left 280 applicants competing for the 120 advertised positions.
column2: 对潜在员工进行了一系列测试和面试，最终有280名申请人竞争着120个已公布的职位。

column1: After the final interview, potential recruits were divided into three categories.
column2: 在最终面试之后，潜在候选人被分为三类。

column1: Category A was for applicants exhibiting strong leadership qualities, Category C was for applicants perceived to be followers, and Category B was for applicants with both leader and follower qualities.
column2: A类适用于那些具备卓越领导能力的申请者；C类适用于那些被视作较为随从的申请者；B类则适用于同时具备领导能力和随从能力的申请者。

column1: Department heads and shift leaders then composed prospective teams using a combination of people from all three categories.
column2: 各部门负责人和班组长随后结合来自三类人员的成员，组建预期团队。

column1: Once suitable teams were formed, offers of employment were made to team members.
column2: 一旦确定了合适的团队，便向团队成员发出录用通知。

column1: Another major initiative by SAH was to adopt a totally multi-skilled workforce.
column2: SAH的另一项重要举措是全面推行多技能员工队伍。

column1: Although there may be some limitations with highly technical jobs such as cooking or maintenance, wherever possible, employees at SAH are able to work in a wide variety of positions.
column2: 尽管在烹饪或维修等高度技术性工作中可能存在一些局限，但SAH公司尽可能让员工在多种岗位上工作。

column1: A multi-skilled workforce provides far greater management flexibility during peak and quiet times to transfer employees to needed positions.
column2: 拥有多技能的人才队伍能够在业务高峰期和低谷期实现更灵活的管理方式，从而将员工调派到需要的岗位上去。

column1: For example, when office staff are away on holidays during quiet periods of the year, employees in either food or beverage or housekeeping departments can temporarily.
column2: 例如，在一年中业务相对清淡的假期期间，如果办公室员工无法上班，那么食品、饮料或物业管理等部门的人员就可以临时接替他们的工作。

column1: The most crucial way, however, of improving the labour cost structure at SAH was to find better, more productive ways of providing customer service.
column2: 然而，改善SAH劳动力成本结构最关键的方法，是找到更高效、更具生产力的客户服务方式。

column1: SAH management concluded this would first require a process of ‘benchmarking’.
column2: SAH的管理层认为，首先需要进行‘基准测试’工作。

column1: The prime objective of the benchmarking process was to compare a range of service delivery processes across a range of criteria using teams made up of employees from different departments within the hotel which interacted with each other.
column2: 进行基准测试的主要目的，是通过一系列标准来比较不同服务流程的表现。这些团队由酒店内不同部门的员工组成，他们之间会相互交流、合作以评估各项服务流程的优劣。

column1: This process resulted in performance measures that greatly enhanced SAH’s ability to improve productivity and quality.
column2: 这一过程产生了显著提升SAH提升生产力和质量能力的绩效指标。

column1: The front office team discovered through this project that a high proportion of AHI Club member reservations were incomplete.
column2: 通过该项目，前台团队发现AHI俱乐部会员的预订信息中存在大量不完整的情况。

column1: As a result, the service provided to these guests was below the standard promised to them as part of their membership agreement.
column2: 因此，这些会员所获得的服务质量低于会员协议中承诺的标准。

column1: Reducing the number of incomplete reservations greatly improved guest perceptions of service.
column2: 大幅减少未完成预订的数量显著提升了客人对服务的感知。

column1: In addition, a program modelled on an earlier project called ‘Take Charge’ was implemented.
column2: 此外，实施了一个以早期项目‘Take Charge’为蓝本的计划。

column1: Essentially, Take Charge provides an effective feedback loop from both customers and employees.
column2: 本质上，Take Charge 提供了一个有效的反馈循环，同时整合来自客户和员工的反馈。

column1: Customer comments, both positive and negative, are recorded by staff.
column2: 员工会记录下顾客的正面和负面评论。

column1: These are collated regularly to identify opportunities for improvement.
column2: 这些信息会定期被整理，以发现改进机会。

column1: Just as importantly, employees are requested to note down their own suggestions for improvement.
column2: 同样重要的是，员工也被要求记录下他们自己提出的改进建议。

column1: (AHI has set an expectation that employees will submit at least three suggestions for every one they receive from a customer.)
column2: AHI要求员工每收到一个客户建议，就必须提交至少三个建议。

column1: Employee feedback is reviewed daily and suggestions are implemented within 48 hours, if possible, or a valid reason is given for non-implementation.
column2: 员工的反馈每天都会被审查，建议在48小时内实施，若不可行，则提供一个合理的理由。

column1: If suggestions require analysis or data collection, the Take Charge team has 30 days in which to address the issue and come up with recommendations.
column2: 如果相关建议需要分析或数据收集，Take Charge团队有30天的时间来处理这些问题并提出相应的建议。

column1: Although quantitative evidence of AHI’s initiatives at SAH are limited at present, the anecdotal evidence clearly suggests that these practices are working.
column2: 尽管目前关于SAH地区AHI举措的定量证据有限，但轶事证据清楚表明这些做法正在发挥作用。

column1: Indeed AHI is progressively rolling out these initiatives in other hotels in Australia, whilst numerous overseas visitors have come to see how the program works.
column2: 事实上，AHI正在澳大利亚的其他酒店逐步推行这些举措，同时许多海外游客也前来参观了解该计划的运作方式。
